The correct supremum is 85/12096 ≈ 0.007027, which none of the three solutions gives.

Solution 1's coefficient expression matches my independent derivation, but its claimed maximum of 1/144 is only the value at c₁ = 0. Taking c₁ = √(2/21), c₂ = 19/21, c₃ = −√(2/21)·19/21 (the Schwarz function ω(z) = z(z+r)/(1+rz) with r = √(2/21)) gives |Γ₁Γ₃ − Γ₂²| = 85/12096 > 1/144 = 84/12096. Solution 3's coefficient formulas for a₄ and Γ₃ are wrong, and Solution 2 is unsupported.
